producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 96 BPM, 4/4 with a lazy shuffle, A major. Slow, swaying and hazy.

VOICE: Mostly instrumental. A man and a woman sing soft wordless notes and one three-word phrase, far back in reverb, as texture.

INSTRUMENTS: A clean electric guitar with spring reverb and a little wah playing a liquid melody, a soft, round bass guitar, a slow shuffling drum kit with brushes, congas and shaker, a quiet organ, cicadas and a creaking rope.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar. 0:16 Section A, bass and beat. 0:44 Voices. 1:04 Section B. 1:36 Voices. 1:52 Break, guitar alone. 2:08 Section C. 2:44 Outro, guitar slowing, ends 3:18.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-2010s psychedelic downtempo: warm, dry rhythm section with a wet, shimmering guitar on top.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The guitar line alone with the rope creak at 1:52.

STATION FIT: Sunday, 1 p.m. The laziest track in the set, nearly instrumental, for the hottest hour.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Drowsy, swaying, emptier, asleep.
